connector.name: IT Glue by selic
connector.registryDescription: IT Glue MCP server for MSPs - documents, flexible assets, semantic vector search, RBAC, and BYOK
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-itglue. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the selic account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ITGLUE_API_KEY
env.description: IT Glue API key (Account → Settings → API Keys)

env.name: ITGLUE_REGION
env.description: IT Glue region: us, eu, or au

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key — enables semantic vector search tools

env.name: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Azure OpenAI API key — enables vector search via Azure (requires AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT)

env.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Embedding model or Azure deployment name

env.name: ITGLUE_ADVANCED_TOOLSET
env.description: true/1 registers the advanced toolset (itglue_get, itglue_find_endpoint) — an opt-in read-only escape hatch; password resources stay blocked

env.name: VECTOR_INDEX_PATH
env.description: Path of the persisted vector index file
